topic: Deployment of impression and Lithuania data
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on correcting and deploying analytics data. Initially, the participants addressed discrepancies in impression counts, specifically a fix for overcounted impressions that needed to be moved from staging to production (prod). Later, they worked on integrating data for Lithuania, which required adjusting custom scripts because the new Change Handler (CH) was incompatible with older methods. Finally, both the impression fix and the updated data set for Lithuania were successfully deployed to production.
decisions: Deploy the fix for overcounted impressions to production.
Move the recalculated data for Lithuania from staging to production.
action_items: The participant with [me] will deploy the impression fix and Lithuania data to production.
